purpose: Index governing rules without duplicating them; make scope, authority, precedence, conflicts and update paths explicit.

laws: POLICIES ARE SCOPED. A rule governs only the surfaces/actions it names or clearly owns.
REFERENCE, DO NOT COPY. Tasks should cite canonical policy paths instead of embedding divergent copies.
MORE SPECIFIC VALID POLICY OVERRIDES A MORE GENERAL POLICY WITHIN ITS SCOPE; IT DOES NOT ERASE THE GENERAL POLICY ELSEWHERE.
SAFETY / PRIVACY / AUTHORITY BOUNDARIES OUTRANK CONVENIENCE, AESTHETICS, SPEED AND AUTOMATION.
OBSERVED REPO/DEVICE/ACCOUNT STATE OUTRANKS A STALE POLICY POINTER; FIX THE POINTER, DO NOT PRETEND THE STATE MATCHES.
CONFLICTS ARE PRESERVED AND RETURNED. Do not silently reconcile contradictory rules.
POLICY CHANGE REQUIRES: source → scope → delta → affected dependents → receipt.
TEMPORARY TASK INSTRUCTIONS DO NOT BECOME STANDING POLICY UNLESS PROMOTED INTO THIS INDEX.
NO POLICY PROLIFERATION: prefer amending/cross-referencing an existing authority over creating a synonym document.
conflict_resolution: 1. Stop the consequential action if authority is unclear.
2. Identify exact conflicting policy paths and scopes.
3. Prefer the more specific valid policy only within overlapping scope.
4. Preserve unresolved contradiction in the RETURN.
5. Amend the canonical source or index; do not patch copies downstream.

authorities.scope: global collaboration orientation, scale, drift response
current heads, active fronts, current pointers
migration role, non-goals, evidence classes, history
≤3 current migration moves and open exact-source gaps
Hermes worker authority, cadence, tasks, return contract
public surface promotion, naming, appslop/card/dashboard rejection
human communication authority, disclosure, routing and RETURN
shared meanings of BACK / PARENT / UNDO / RETURN / REPLAY / RESTORE / RESET / RE_ENTER / ESC
instrument purpose/power/proof/promise/price/return boundaries and shared motifs

task_rule: Before a persistent agent/automation acts, it should resolve the smallest applicable policy set from this index, cite those paths in its receipt, and avoid copying their prose into task-local doctrine.
update_rule: When a policy is added or materially changed, update this index and name affected consumers; do not silently fan the change out by hand.
